title: tool_docs source-scan tests are blind in CoW-seeded worktrees until bbox-tool-docs recompiles
wanted_capability: every_registered_tool_has_a_doc / description_summary_parity should always scan the source tree of the checkout the tests run in. They resolve src/ via compile-time env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"), so a test binary carried into a worktree by the seed_dirs CoW target/ clone (or any cached build) scans the checkout it was COMPILED in. Observed live during the badgey dissolution: 4 new consultant_* #[tool] handlers added in a worktree passed the coverage test (binary scanned the base repo, which lacked them); the gap only surfaced after editing tool_docs.rs forced a recompile. Fix direction: resolve the scan root at runtime (e.g. walk up from std::env::current_dir() to the workspace root, or pass the root via a runtime env var nextest sets), or assert the baked path matches the runtime workspace and fail loudly on mismatch.
missing_primitive: Runtime-rooted source scan (or baked-path-vs-runtime-root mismatch guard) in bbox-tool-docs source-parsing tests.
fallback_used: Touched crates/bbox-tool-docs/src/tool_docs.rs (adding the consultant_ prefix + stanzas) which forced a recompile in the worktree, re-rooting the scan correctly.
